items.claim: Jeremiah Wells has powerful striking and pretty good counters.
items.quote: he's just powerful and has pretty good counters.

items.claim: Jeremiah Wells is less effective when he is forced to push the pace in striking and put together combinations.
items.quote: He isn't as good when he's the one that has to push the push the striking on people.

items.claim: Jeremiah Wells is an expert at the rear naked choke once he gets to his opponent's back.
items.quote: once he gets to the back, he's an expert with the rear naked choke.

items.claim: Trevin Giles relies heavily on the standing guillotine for his wins.
items.quote: They're nearly all standing guillotine finishes.

items.claim: Vicente Luque suffered a significant brain injury in the Geoff Neal fight that impacts his career longevity.
items.quote: that Geoff Neal fight where we we we talked about the brain injury. You don't really bounce back from a brain injury

items.claim: Lucas Fernando has a hard time getting back to his feet and his takedown defense is not great.
items.quote: he has a hard time getting back to his feet, and his takedown defense is not great.

items.claim: Rafael Tobias is extremely uncomfortable on the feet and outmatched in the striking department.
items.quote: he is extremely uncomfortable on the feet, and he is absolutely outmatched for every second that this is on the feet.

items.claim: Jose Ochoa has very good knees that he uses effectively in the clinch and at striking range.
items.quote: The thing I like the best about him is his knees. He uses them very well both in the clinch... but also in just at striking range.
